name: RRWallet
rootCause: Security firm Coinspect disclosed that RRWallet (RenrenBit’s wallet) generated vulnerable seed phrases due to a weak RNG in the CryptoJS library (Ill Bloom vulnerability, CVE-2026-71851), making private keys predictable and leading to theft. One user lost approximately $2 million.

descriptions.text: Security firm Coinspect disclosed that RRWallet (RenrenBit’s wallet) generated vulnerable seed phrases due to a weak RNG in the CryptoJS library (Ill Bloom vulnerability, CVE-2026-71851), making private keys predictable and leading to theft. One user lost approximately $2 million.

RRWallet, a Bitcoin wallet app, was exploited on August 6, 2026, losing around $2 million after attackers brute-forced private keys generated by a weak random number generator in the CryptoJS library. The vulnerable recovery phrases could be predicted, leaving all wallets created by RRWallet at risk. No patch was released, and users are advised to migrate funds immediately. RRWallet used CryptoJS.lib.WordArray.random(), a weak random number generator seeded by Math.random(), to generate wallet recovery phrases. This produced insufficient entropy (search space ~2^39,2^47 rather than 2^128+), making private keys brute-forceable. The app was discontinued and unrepaired.
